steps: View, offset and resize modes are mutually exclusive. Box resize mode exposes only east, south and southeast handles. Switching mode and a zero-distance handle gesture do not dirty fields or sources. The disposable original already has offset X=2 spelled 2e0.

Actual noncentral handle grabs use the inverse SVG CTM under zoom and horizontal letterboxing. East changes width by twice horizontal displacement, south changes height by twice vertical displacement, and southeast changes both. Ghosts leave form values/source bytes untouched until pointer release; centers stay at (102,180). Untouched raw input spelling, including 2e0 and -0.00 offsets, remains exact. Each commit hides the unchecked view and revokes Apply until Check.

Escape, switching to offset mode and saved-position refresh cancel active resize ghosts without changing fields. Cancelling the reviewed form keeps the original source. A held geometry result from that closed form cannot replace unfinished input after reopening.

All actual handle gestures across box width/height bounds 1..8192 and circle radius bounds 0.5..4096 are rejected without clamping. Both axes, original numeric spellings, center/offset and previous checked review remain exact; the rejection remains visible after release. Circle mode exposes only its east radius handle.

Circle drag changes radius by horizontal scene displacement only, ignoring vertical motion and preserving center/offset. Actual Shift-click and Shift-arrow adjust by 10; ordinary controls adjust by 1. The final radius 12 is produced through the new resize controls. Arrow keys inside the numeric input do not resize. The reviewed source changes only the first body shape and preserves offset 2e0, BOM/CRLF, escaped keys and other bodies verbatim.

Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain focused resize controls, exact input nodes and the reviewed source. Radius controls fit horizontally, circles retain proportions and the dialog keeps Check/Apply/Cancel visible.

Transport failure leaves the checked source review and ordinary Apply path intact. A missing instance retains its declaration but exposes no resize handles; restoring saved scene geometry restores the correct controls without altering the reviewed candidate.

Apply changes only the ordinary source draft; reopening displays its checked collision geometry over saved actor positions. Cancel keeps that draft. Ordinary Save changes only the exact reviewed physics source, preserving BOM, CRLF, escaped key and untouched body text. No resource bytes are fetched.

GUI Plan, Build and real Godot headless Run consume the saved circle radius 12 and local offset X 2. Character stops at x≈131; actual sensor enter/exit publishes the other instance UUID from its sensor binding. Animation completes idle/action/idle under unchanged project protocol 10.
